data.body: **[P2] End nonvirtual children whose persistence is rejected.** When early parent completion makes persistence return false, this completes a nested child in memory but fires `onOperationEnd` only for virtual children. Since the nested child received `onOperationStart`, execution-scoped plugins are left unbalanced and may omit its span. Distinguish replay from parent-rejected persistence and emit the end hook for current-invocation nonvirtual success and failure paths; add a nested early-completion lifecycle test.
